home.title: Focus
home.noAppsWarning: This profile has no allowed apps. Phone, messages and emergency calls always stay available.

unlock.title: Really stop?
unlock.countdown: Wait {{seconds}} s and think about whether you really need to.
unlock.sentenceText: I want to interrupt my focus now.

blocked.message: This app is turned off during focus mode

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.name: Name
profiles.iosHint: iOS does not expose a list of apps. You choose in the system picker and we never see app names.
profiles.alwaysAllowed: Phone, messages and emergency calls are always allowed.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: No schedule yet. Focus mode will start by itself on the days and hours you choose.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accessibilityHint: Optional. More reliable blocking, but requires the Accessibility permission.

onboarding.welcomeBody: When focus mode is on, only the apps you allowed in advance stay available. Everything else is hidden or blocked. Your data stays on this phone: no account, no ads.

usageAccess.title: Usage access
usageAccess.why: We need to know which app is in the foreground so a non-allowed one can be blocked.

overlay.title: Display over other apps
overlay.why: This lets us show the blocking screen on top of a non-allowed app.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.why: Android requires a persistent notification while focus mode runs. We send no other notifications.

batteryOptimization.title: Battery optimization exemption
batteryOptimization.why: So the system does not stop focus mode while you are focusing.

defaultLauncher.title: Default home app
defaultLauncher.why: During focus mode we show only a grid of allowed apps.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.why: Optional. Detects the open app more reliably. We do not read or store anything else on screen.

screenTime.title: Screen Time
screenTime.why: Apple requires your consent before we can restrict apps. Your selection stays on the device.
